scripts.lint: pnpm exec eslint . --max-warnings=0 && pnpm --dir apps/edge-service run lint && pnpm --dir apps/terminal-simulator run lint && pnpm --dir apps/cloud-api run lint
scripts.format:check: pnpm exec prettier --check . && pnpm --dir apps/edge-service run format:check && pnpm --dir apps/terminal-simulator run format:check && pnpm --dir apps/cloud-api run format:check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir apps/web run typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/edge-service run typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/terminal-simulator run typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/cloud-api run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --dir apps/web run test && pnpm --dir packages/contracts run test && pnpm --dir packages/test-fixtures run test && pnpm --dir apps/edge-service run test && pnpm --dir apps/terminal-simulator run test && pnpm --dir apps/cloud-api run test
scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/web run build && pnpm --dir apps/edge-service run build && pnpm --dir apps/terminal-simulator run build && pnpm --dir apps/cloud-api run build
scripts.validate: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm spellcheck && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm build
